model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази диаграма представлява разбивка на различните области на изследвания в областта на машинното обучение, като всяка област е представена като отделен сектор. В диаграмата са включени общо седем сектора, които са етикетирани като "General", "Scaling", "Drafting", "Speculative Decoding", "Data Clustering", "Reinforcement Learning" и "Knowledge-Guided Decoding". Секторът "Scaling" е оцветен в синьо, а "Drafting" е оцветен в зелено. Секторът "Speculative Decoding" е почти два пъти по-голям от другите и е визуално подчертан, показвайки неговата значимост. Останалите сектори са оцветени в различни шарки. В диаграмата има легенда, която описва всеки сектор и съответния цвят.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates the accuracy results and the inference cost of the draft model. The chart displays seven slices representing different categories: “Speculative Decoding Approach,” “Baseline Model,” “Online Task Dataset,” “Collected Dataset,” “Target Model,” “Target Draft,” and “Wildcard.” The “Speculative Decoding Approach” slice is colored red and occupies approximately 30% of the chart, while the “Baseline Model” slice, colored blue, represents approximately 25%. The “Online Task Dataset” slice, colored green, accounts for roughly 14%, followed by the “Collected Dataset” slice, colored yellow, at approximately 13%. The “Target Model” slice, colored orange, occupies about 8%, the “Target Draft” slice, colored purple, represents approximately 6%, and the “Wildcard” slice, colored grey, represents about 3%. A legend is provided, detailing the color coding for each category.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Kreisdiagramm stellt die Genauigkeitsergebnisse auf der Grundlage der Fehlerverifizierung des im Vergleich zum ursprünglichen Modell erstellten Entwurfs dar. Die Darstellung umfasst sieben Segmente, die mit „Current optimization in speculative decoding“, „Higher drafting accuracy“, „Scaling law“, „Achieving higher drafting accuracy typically requires larger or more complex draft models“, „Drafting strategies improve the number of candidate tokens“, „Implementing draft speculative decoding“, „and using the targeted model to generate draft to enhance its ability to scale between one hand and another“ beschriftet sind. Die Segmente sind in der Reihenfolge der Größe angeordnet, wobei die Segmente von links nach rechts mit zunehmender Größe zusammenwachsen. Innerhalb jedes Segments sind ungefähre Prozentangaben angegeben, die wie folgt aussehen: „Current optimization in speculative decoding“ (etwa 37 %), „Higher drafting accuracy“ (etwa 34 %), „Scaling law“ (etwa 15 %), „Achieving higher drafting accuracy typically requires larger or more complex draft models“ (etwa 8 %), „Drafting strategies improve the number of candidate tokens“ (etwa 6 %), „Implementing draft speculative decoding“ (etwa 5 %) und „and using the targeted model to generate draft to enhance its ability to scale between one hand and another“ (etwa 5 %). Es wird eine Legende bereitgestellt, die die Farben der Segmente zuordnet.
